description: exFAT read reuse, overlay mutation and independent direct-write qualification
decisions: Read-only baseline work may proceed after track 001; track 002 dependency applies to write mounts.
embedded-exfat remains conditional on upstream unsafe-code admission.

Both fsck.exfat and Windows chkdsk evidence are required for accepted writes.
